deck.title: Why was Hitler Able to Dominate Germany by 1934?

front_blocks.md: Define **DAP**.

back_blocks.md: The **DAP** (German Workers' Party) was a right-wing party founded by **Anton Drexler** in February 1919 that targeted the working classes.

back_blocks.md: The **Twenty-Five Point Programme** was the political programme written by Hitler and Drexler in January 1920 that formalised the party's aims, mixing **nationalist and socialist** ideas.

back_blocks.md: **True.**
